# Zippia

> > Zippia is a comprehensive career platform offering job search, resume building, interview preparation, salary insights, and career matching tools powered by AI.

Zippia provides job seekers with resources for finding opportunities, optimizing applications through ATS-friendly resume building, preparing for interviews, and understanding compensation across industries. The platform combines career guidance, company insights, and practical tools to support users throughout their job search journey.

## Key Topics

- Job Search
- Resume Building
- Interview Preparation
- Career Matching
- ATS Optimization
- Salary Information
- Cover Letters
- Career Advice
- Common Interview Questions
- Behavioral Questions
- Job Application Tools
- Career Guidance
- Company Insights
- Answer Examples
- Interview Tips

## Core Platform

- [Zippia - Find Jobs, Salaries, Companies, Resume Help, Career Paths, and More](https://www.zippia.com): Zippia homepage: job search, resume building, career matching, and salary information

## Resume & Application

- [How To Write A Resume In 7 Steps (With Examples) - Zippia](https://www.zippia.com/advice/how-to-write-a-resume): Step-by-step resume writing guide with ATS optimization tips by Matthew Zane
- [How To Write A Cover Letter For A Job In 2026 (With Examples) - Zippia](https://www.zippia.com/advice/how-to-write-a-cover-letter): Cover letter writing guide with templates and best practices by Chris Kolmar

## Interview Preparation

- [50 Interview Questions And Answers [2023] - Zippia](https://www.zippia.com/advice/interview-questions): Interview preparation guide with 50 common questions and answers by Chris Kolmar
